silhouette.reason: The curved legs, arch, platforms and see-through lattice name the Eiffel Tower from the outline in every view.
fixes: open the lattice between the upper-shaft corner posts slightly more

proportions.reason: 125 × 125 × 330 m; deck heights and leg spread match the elevation by eye.
fixes: check the second-deck width against the elevation plate by overlay

materials.reason: Bronze-brown painted iron reads, deck floors and the antenna separate; the paint is one uniform tone from base to top.
fixes: slightly glossier, fresher paint on the upper shaft and a three-tone gradient (darker at the base) as on the real tower

detail.reason: Lattice bracing, deck railings and the top campanile hold in the portrait close-up.
fixes: mid rails on the deck railings with square posts

wear.reason: Some darkening at the base, but at render distance no rust streaks below nodes or dirt on deck tops are visible.
fixes: stronger rust streaks below the lattice nodes on the lower legs; dirt on the deck tops

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 is four opaque solid brown frustums: the see-through lattice becomes a solid mass, a clear density and value pop at the switch.
fixes: an alpha-cutout lattice strip on the LOD2 frustums so it stays see-through at distance
instance repeated lattice panels to cut LOD0 file size
